spans.s:
m. (-खुः)
1 A rat, a mouse.
2 A hog.
3 A thief.
4 A sort of tree: see देबताड.
E.
आङ्, खन to dig, and कु Uṇādi aff.

f. (-र्णी)
The name of a plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
आखु a mouse, and कर्ण an ear; the leaves are compared to the ears of a mouse.

A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
आखु a rat, and ग who goes; GAṆEŚA is represented riding on a rat.

m. (-तः)
A Śūdra or man of low cast and profession, lit. a rat-catcher.
E.
आखु and घात a blow.

f. (-का)
A plant: see आखुकर्णी.
E.
आखु and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-णः)
A kind of mineral, a loadstone.
E.
आखु and पाषाण a stone.

m. (-भुक्)
A cat.
E.
आखु and भुज् who eats.

m. (-थः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
आखु and रथ a carriage; whose vehicle is a rat.

f. (-हा)
A kind of grass: (Andropogon serratum.)
E.
आखु, बिष venom, and हा what destroys; considered as a remedy for the bite of a rat.

m. (-त्थः)
The rising up or coming of rats, a swarm of rats.
E.
आखु and उत्थ from उत् and स्था with क aff.
